fine_lines.title: excited vs nervous
fine_lines.explanation_ar: excited = متحمّس وسعيد لشيء قادم. nervous = متوتر وقلق قليلاً. يمكن أن تشعر بالاثنين معاً قبل حدث كبير.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Excited = happy and eager about something coming. Nervous = a little worried. You can feel both before a big event.

examples.sentence: I'm excited about my new job.

fine_lines.title: going to vs will
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما للمستقبل. be going to للخطط أو لشيء نراه سيحدث (Some people are going to watch your show). will للتوقع أو القرار الآن أو الوعد (They'll tell me what they liked).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both talk about the future. Be going to is for plans or something we can see coming. Will is for predictions, quick decisions and promises.

examples.sentence: Today you are going to watch my new show.
They'll tell me what they liked.

fine_lines.title: usual vs unusual
fine_lines.explanation_ar: usual = عادي ومعتاد. unusual = غير عادي. البادئة un تعني «غير».
fine_lines.explanation_en: Usual = normal. Unusual = not normal, special. The prefix un- means "not".

examples.sentence: This is not a usual treehouse.
It's an unusual treehouse. It can time travel!

grammar.title: Future with be going to
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم am / is / are + going to + الفعل الأساسي للحديث عن الخطط والأشياء المؤكدة في المستقبل. السؤال: Is Anna going to be lost? النفي: I'm not going to...
grammar.explanation_en: Use am / is / are + going to + base verb for plans and things we expect in the future. Question: Is Anna going to be lost? Negative: I'm not going to...
examples: Some people are going to watch your children's show.
Today you are going to watch my new show.
Is Anna going to be lost forever?

grammar.title: Future with will
grammar.explanation_ar: will + الفعل الأساسي للتوقعات والأسئلة عن المستقبل، مع كل الضمائر بدون s. الاختصار: they'll، I'll. السؤال: Will the shark eat her?
grammar.explanation_en: Use will + base verb for predictions and future questions. It is the same for all subjects, with no -s. Short form: they'll, I'll. Question: Will the shark eat her?
examples: After they watch it, they'll tell me what they liked.

grammar.title: how to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم how to + الفعل الأساسي بعد know / learn / teach للحديث عن طريقة فعل شيء: I don't know how to ski = لا أعرف كيف أتزلج.
grammar.explanation_en: Use how to + base verb after know / learn / teach to talk about the way to do something.
examples: Layla wants to know how to play baseball.
That is a good place to learn how to ski.
I don't know how to ski!
